verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs describe a Publishing feature that turns the graph into a browsable single-page web app, with selective control: no pages are public by default and individual pages opt in via `publish:: true`. A community user also says they appreciate the publishing features. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that page and block links work in the published site, evidence that hosting or deployment happens without leaving the app, and in-depth hands-on corroboration of the published output.
